name: component_capability_evolver
description: Reusable periodic evolution review. A normal Model judges whether repeated work deserves a reusable artifact, then a bounded Agent searches before proposing or creating it.

component.name: capability_evolver
component.description: Turn repeated failures or repeated work into a Skill, Tool, Knowledge or SubDAG without keyword hardcoding.

evolver.description: Identity that evaluates and implements reusable capabilities

judge_verification.description: Require evidence before an evolution is marked successful

approve.prompt_text:
允许 Agent 搜索并在确实没有重复能力时实现以下进化候选吗？
${ctx.evolution_decision}

evolve.instructions:
Search exactly once before changing anything for this approved proposal: ${ctx.evolution_decision}
Call search_capabilities with the proposed search_query and relevant kinds. Do not create or activate in this node.

implement.instructions:
Review the immediately preceding search result and this approved proposal: ${ctx.evolution_decision}
Perform exactly one action. If an adequate capability exists, activate it. Otherwise create the smallest proposed artifact. For create_skill, pass parameters_schema as an actual JSON object (not a JSON-encoded string); its public properties must exactly match the Python function signature and must omit runtime-only _context. A workspace-aware function itself should accept optional _context=None and resolve the workspace from (_context or {}).get('workspace') or os.getcwd(). Code must use the exact filenames, units, note grammar and every example in the task evidence; do not hardcode an evidence mapping as a fallback when the task requires reading notes. For a Harness, publish typed component inputs/outputs. Do not search again. A write is not yet success; the following nodes verify it.

repair.instructions:
The single mutation attempt failed with this exact evidence: ${ctx.mutation_evidence}
Correct only the reported interface/validation problem and retry the same approved action exactly once. Do not search, propose a different capability, test copied code, or claim success without a successful tool result.

verify.instructions: Verify the successful persisted activation or mutation against the proposal acceptance_test. Perform exactly one highest-value check: for a Skill, import the function from the absolute scripts/<skill_name>.py path returned by create_skill and run every acceptance assertion including the error case; never test copied/equivalent inline code. The process already runs in the Task workspace: do not use cd and do not pass cwd. If the Skill reads workspace files, call it with _context={'workspace': os.getcwd()}. For Knowledge/Harness inspect or run the persisted artifact; for activation query the catalog. Ensure the command prints an explicit PASS marker. Do not mutate and do not perform multiple searches.

verification_repair.instructions:
The first verification call failed or was blocked: ${ctx.verification_evidence}
Retry the same persisted-artifact acceptance check exactly once. For run_command, do not use cd and omit cwd; the process already starts in the Task workspace. Import the persisted Skill by its absolute scripts path, pass _context={'workspace': os.getcwd()}, execute every assertion, and print PASS. Do not mutate or test copied inline code.

value.reason: The deterministic verification tool failed; model self-report was not accepted.

verification_report.instructions: Report the evolution action and its concrete verification result. Include capability name/path, the exact check, exit status or catalog evidence, and any failure. Do not call tools.
